item.content:encoded: It's what I would like to describe as "perspective based" humor. It's dark humor for us, sure, but to some nobody researcher trapped in a pocket dimension, it's terrifying. And yeah, it's definitely a bit short, but I plan to lengthen out tales written in the same format more in the future.

I loved thinking of the possible situations that led to 'Reentry into another person'
Just a question- is this meant to be taken lightly? Or seriously with an edge of morbid humor? Either way, I liked it, but it could do with a bit more length!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: This tries to pull in two different directions tonally and is made the worse for it. Details like "Pg.247/Chapter-24 - Erratic Trans Dimensional Travel" indicate that this document is supposed to be semiserious in-universe, but lines like "If you are unsure of your current state of being, please flip to page 272 of this handbook "Existing and why it is important to productivity" for more information." are satirical in the vein of Portal. The problem is that the Foundation in-universe is nowhere near as incompetent as Aperture Science, so the tone is inconsistent and I'm left scratching my head as to who would write this guidebook or what its purpose is.

item.content:encoded:
The last line was kind of amusing, but ultimately there's just not a lot going on here. The "narrative" in this case would be the various steps it implies for you to seek escape or protect yourself, which is pretty much "move towards/away from things" and also to a lesser extent the things that could happen to you, but the repeated joke with a bunch of thing/thing/things does not a story make.

-1
